source.text: እምሕል፡ ለክሙ፡ እስመ፡ በሰማይ፡ ይዜከሩ፡ መላእክት፡ በእንቲአክሙ፡ ለሠናይ፡ በ*ቅድመ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ለዐቢይ፡ ወእስማቲከሙ፡ ይጸሐፍ፡ በቅድመ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ለዐቢይ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: I swear to you that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One, and your names will be written before the glory of the Great One.

source.text: ተስፈዉ፡ እስመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ኃሠርክሙ፡ በእኩይ፡ ወ*በምራኅ፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ ትበርሁ፡ ከመ፡ ብርሃነ፡ ሰማይ፡ ትበርሁ፡ ወ*ትትረአዩ፡ ወ*ኆኅተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ይትረኀዉ፡ ለክሙ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Have hope, because formerly you were put to shame through evil and affliction. But now you will shine like the light of heaven; you will shine and be seen, and the portals of heaven will be opened for you.[a]

footnotes.text: The printed text repeats “you will shine.” Its apparatus records differing readings for the shining and being-seen wording. The repetition is retained rather than silently shortened.

source.text: ወጽራኅ፡ ዚአክሙ፡ ኵነኒ፡ ጽርኁ፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ለክሙ፡ እስመ፡ እምነ፡ መላእክት፡ ይትኃሠሥ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምንዳቤክሙ፡ ወእምኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ አርደእዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ የሀይዱክሙ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: As for your cry, cry out for judgment, and he will make it appear to you,[a] because all your suffering will be required of the angels and of all those who helped those who drive you away.[b]

footnotes.text: The opening joins “your cry,” judgment, and the command to cry out. The following verb means to cause to appear or show, with no explicit object; “it” refers contextually to the requested judgment.
The selected edition prints “angels” here. This is the wording of the edited text, not a substitution of rulers or a claim that independent manuscripts have been checked.

source.text: ተስፈዉ፡ ወኢትኅድጉ፡ ተስፋክሙ፡ እስመ፡ ትከውን፡ ለክሙ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ከመ፡ መላእክተ፡ ሰማይ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Have hope, and do not abandon your hope, because great joy will be yours, like the angels of heaven.

source.text: ምንተ፡ ሀለወክሙ፡ ትግበሩ፡ አኮ፡ ትትኀብኡ፡ ሀለወክሙ፡ በዕለተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወኢ*ትትረከቡ፡ ከመ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወኵነኔ፡ እንተ፡ ለዓለም፡ ትከውን፡ እምኔክሙ፡ ለእሉ፡ ትውልደ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: What must you do? You will not have to hide on the day of great judgment, and you will not be found like sinners. Eternal judgment will be away from you for all the generations of the world.[a]

footnotes.text: The final expression is more literally “judgment ... will be from you.” “Away from you” expresses the separating force of “from”; no additional punishment of the righteous is supplied.

source.text: ወይእዜኒ፡ ኢትፍርሁ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ሶበ፡ ትሬእይዎሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ይጸንዑ፡ ወይደልዉ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ኢትኩኑ፡ ሱቱፋነ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ አላ፡ ርሐቁ፡ እምግፍዐ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ ለ*ኄራነ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሀለወክሙ፡ ትኩኑ፡ ሱቱፋነ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Now, righteous ones, do not be afraid when you see sinners growing strong and their ways prospering. Do not become their partners, but keep far from their violence, because you are to become partners with the good ones of heaven.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected main text says “good ones of heaven.” Charles’s apparatus at printed page 217 note 39 suggests, following Flemming, that this may reflect a corruption for “angels”; that suggestion is not silently installed in the translation.

source.text: ወእስመ፡ ትብሉ፡ *አንትሙ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ኢ*ትትኀሠሡ፡ ወኢ*ይጽሐፉ፡ *ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትነ፡ *ይጽሐፉ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትክሙ፡ *በኵሉ፡ ዕለት።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Because you sinners say, “You are not called to account, and all our sins are not written down”—all your sins are being written down every day.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected Ge’ez shifts from addressing “you sinners” to the second-person “you are not called to account,” then to “our sins” inside the saying, and back to “your sins.” These person shifts are retained rather than silently replacing the second person with “we.” The following assertion contradicts the sinners’ denial.

source.text: ወይእዜኒ፡ አነ፡ አርእየክሙ፡ እስመ፡ *ብርሃን፡ ወጽልመት፡ *ዕለት፡ ወሌሊት፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትክሙ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Now I show you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.[a]

footnotes.text: The verse personifies light and darkness, day and night, as seeing the sins. The translation retains that imagery rather than reducing it to an abstract statement about visibility.

source.text: ኢትርሥዑ፡ በልብክሙ፡ ወኢ*ተሐስዉ፡ ወኢትመይጥዋ፡ ለነገረ፡ ርትዕ፡ ወኢ*ትሐስውዋ፡ ለነገረ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወኢ*ትትሕስብዋ፡ ለጣዖትክሙ፡ እስመ፡ አኮነት፡ ኵሉ፡ ሐሰትክሙ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ርኩስነክሙ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ አላ፡ ለኃጢአት፡ ዐቢይ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Do not become wicked in your hearts, do not lie, and do not alter the word of truth. Do not falsify the word of the Holy and Great One, and do not reckon it for your idols,[a] because all your falsehood and all your impurity are not for righteousness but for great sin.

footnotes.text: The selected expression “reckon it for your idols” is difficult. The editor records competing forms of the verb in printed page 218 note 20 and acknowledges that another manuscript reading may be right. This candidate stays close to the selected wording rather than replacing it with a different, unexpressed action.

source.text: ወይእዜኒ፡ አነ፡ አአምር፡ ለዝ፡ ምሥጢር፡ እስመ፡ ነገረ፡ ርትዕ፡ ይመይጡ፡ ወ*የዐልዉ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወይትናገሩ፡ ነገራተ፡ እኩያተ፡ ወይሐስዉ፡ ወይፈጥሩ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ዐቢየተ፡ ወመጻሕፍተ፡ ይጽሐፉ፡ ዲበ፡ ነገራቲሆሙ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Now I know this mystery: many sinners will alter and change the word of truth, speak evil words, lie, invent great creations,[a] and write books about their own words.

footnotes.text: More literally, “create great creations.” The context of evil speech and lying gives the activity a negative force; the Ge’ez does not specify a literary genre for the invented material.

source.text: ወሶበሰ፡ ኵሎ፡ ነገራተ፡ ይጽሐፉ፡ በርትዕ፡ ዲበ፡ ልሳናቲሆሙ፡ ወኢይዌልጡ፡ ወኢ*የሐጽጹ፡ እምነገራቲየ፡ አላ፡ *ኵሎ፡ በርትዕ፡ ይጽሐፉ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ አስማዕኩ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: But when they write all the words truthfully in their languages, neither changing nor diminishing my words, but writing everything truthfully—all that I previously announced concerning them—[a]

footnotes.text: The printed unit begins with a temporal expression, “when,” and repeats the writing clause; it does not supply an explicit main-clause conclusion within this numbered unit. The suspended construction is retained instead of deleting “when” or inventing a consequence.

source.text: ወ*ካልአ፡ ምሥጢረ፡ አእምር፡ እስመ፡ *ለጻድቃን፡ ወለጠበብን፡ ይትወሀብ፡ መጻሕፍታት፡ ለፍሥሓ፡ *ወለርቱዕ፡ ወለጥበብ፡ ብዙኅ፡
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: And I know another mystery: books will be given to the righteous and wise for joy, for uprightness, and for much wisdom.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected edited text distinguishes joy, uprightness, and wisdom. Charles reports variations in these expressions; this translation follows the printed main text rather than silently conflating the three purposes.

source.text: ወሎሙ፡ ይትወሀብ፡ መጻሕፍት፡ ወእሙንቱ፡ የአምኑ፡ ቦሙ፡ ወይትፌሥሑ፡ ቦሙ፡ ወይትዐሠዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እለ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ አእመሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍናዋተ፡ ርቱዕ።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: Books will be given to them, and they will believe in them and rejoice in them. All the righteous who have learned from them all the paths of uprightness will be rewarded.

source.text: በአማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ ይጼውዑ፡ ወያሰምዑ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ምድር፡ በጥበቦሙ፡ አርእዩ፡ ሎሙ፡ እስመ፡ አንትሙ፡ መራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ወ*ዕሥያተ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵላ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: In those days the Lord said, “They will call and make themselves heard to the children of the earth through their wisdom. Show them that you are their guides, and a reward over the whole earth.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected edition shifts from third-person plural verbs, “they will call” and “make heard,” to the command “show them,” addressing “you.” It also calls the addressees “a reward.” This candidate retains those shifts rather than silently harmonizing all the verbs into commands.

source.text: እስመ፡ አነ፡ ወወልድየ፡ ንዴመር፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ በ*ፍናዋተ፡ ርቱዕ፡ በሕይወቶሙ፡ ወ*ሰላም፡ ይከውን፡ ለክሙ፡ ተፈሥሑ፡ ውሉደ፡ ርቱዕ፡ አሜን።
source.note: Fresh bounded collation of actual Charles 1906 selected critical text. Critical signs retained; printed verse labels and superscript apparatus references omitted. This is an unapplied author candidate, not independent manuscript or human-specialist certification.

translation.text: “For I and my son will be joined with them forever on the paths of uprightness in their life, and peace will be yours. Rejoice, children of uprightness. Amen.”[a]

footnotes.text: The Ge’ez explicitly reads “I and my son”; it is not omitted, converted into a different title, or treated as independent proof of the passage’s compositional history. The verse also changes from “with them” to the direct address “yours.”
